title: AI agents (MCP)
hint: Lets AI agents such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor look at your clusters through Sextant. The server listens on this computer only and needs a token. What an agent may do in each cluster is set in that cluster's settings (AI agent access); it can do nothing until you allow it.

port.label: Port
port.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1024 to 65535.
port.hint: Changing the port restarts the server and ends the agents' sessions.

status.error: The MCP server could not start.

token.label: Token
token.hint: Agents send this token with every request. Keep it private: anyone who has it can ask the server for what you have allowed.
token.regenerated: A new token was created. Update the configuration of every agent that used the old one.
token.confirmBody: The current token stops working at once and the agents' sessions are closed. You will need to give every agent the new token.
token.failed: The token could not be read: {{message}}

snippets.title: Connect an agent
snippets.claudeCodeHint: Run this command in a terminal. It contains the token, so keep it private.
snippets.cursorHint: Add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (or .cursor/mcp.json in a project). It contains the token.
snippets.claudeDesktopHint: Add this to the mcpServers section of claude_desktop_config.json. Claude Desktop starts Sextant as a helper that reads the port and the token itself, so the file holds no token. Sextant must be running with the server on.
snippets.tokenHidden: The token is hidden here; Copy puts the real one on the clipboard.
